resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and SummitPost give 1926 for the cab, firelookout.com gives 1925 for a live-in cabin, and Forest Lookouts gives 1928 for a structure. The story reports all three and does not choose one.

Three sources say the lookout burned in 1956 when no longer needed. The register, citing an archaeological report, says it was dismantled and some lumber was burned on site. The story reports both accounts.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: coordinates, 1,724 m elevation, Lewis County and the March 17, 2011 registration match the register. The build year (1925, 1926 or 1928) and the fate (burned 1956 or dismantled) conflict across sources, and the story reports both. Only one source (the register) describes the 1982 finds and the archaeological report. The Forest Service trail page calls the site Cispus Point, while the register and most others use Cispus Mountain; the story keeps Cispus Mountain. The SummitPost road note dates from 2016 and is marked as such. Photo credits on the Forest Lookouts and firelookout pages have no URLs, so no photos are listed.
